title: Keu: red calligraphic script wordmark portfolio
note: Logo inspo. Keu (@rakeuzebio), a Brazilian graphic designer, illustrator and art director now based in Europe, shared her updated portfolio (arakeu.com) on Nov 26, 2026. The wordmark is a large scarlet calligraphic script 'Keu.' with looping swashes and a trailing period, on off-white; it pairs with small red monospace body text and red pill nav buttons (filled WORK, outlined ABOUT). The work grid below mixes vinyl, merch and campaign tiles. Thumbnail is a screenshot of arakeu.com; the 26 s portfolio walkthrough clip (with sound) from her post is attached.
